scene.ko: 지난주에 왔어야 할 택배가 배달 완료로 나오는데 받지 못해 우체국에 문의하고, 주소 번호가 뒤바뀐 것을 찾아 해결한다.

lines.en: Hi. I'm hoping you can help me with a package that never showed up.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 오지 않은 택배 일로 도움을 좀 받을 수 있을까 해서요.
alt: Hi. Could you help me with a package that never arrived?
Hello. A package I was waiting for never came. Can you help me?

lines.en: I can try. Do you have the tracking number?
Yes, here it is. It was supposed to arrive last Friday, but it got delayed. Now it says it was delivered yesterday.
lines.ko: 네, 여기요. 지난 금요일에 오기로 했는데 늦어지더니, 이제는 어제 배달됐다고 나와요.
alt: Yes, this is it. It was due last Friday, but it was delayed, and now it shows as delivered yesterday.

lines.en: Let me look... Hmm, it was scanned as delivered at 1280 Maple Street at 2:15 yesterday.
lines.ko: 확인해 볼게요... 음, 어제 2시 15분에 메이플 스트리트 1280번지에 배달 완료로 찍혔네요.

lines.en: That's not my address. I live at 1208 Maple Street. Could the numbers have been mixed up?
lines.ko: 거긴 제 주소가 아니에요. 저는 메이플 스트리트 1208번지에 살아요. 번호가 뒤바뀐 걸까요?
alt: But I live at 1208, not 1280. Maybe the numbers got mixed up?
That's the wrong address. Mine is 1208 Maple Street. Could someone have switched the numbers?

lines.en: That's very possible. I'm sorry about that. I'll have the carrier go back and pick it up from that house this afternoon.
lines.ko: 충분히 그럴 수 있겠네요. 죄송합니다. 오늘 오후에 집배원이 그 집에 다시 가서 찾아오도록 할게요.

lines.en: Thank you. What happens if it's not there anymore?
lines.ko: 고마워요. 만약 거기 없으면 어떻게 되나요?
alt: Thanks. And what if they can't find it?
Thank you. What if it's gone?

lines.en: Then the sender can file a claim. But usually, people keep packages safe for their neighbors.
lines.ko: 그러면 보낸 분이 보상 청구를 할 수 있어요. 하지만 보통은 이웃분들이 잘 보관해 두세요.

lines.en: I hope so. Would you mind giving me a call once you have it?
lines.ko: 그러면 좋겠네요. 찾으시면 전화 한 통 주시겠어요?
alt: I hope so. Could you call me when you get it?
Fingers crossed. Can you let me know when it's picked up?

lines.en: Not at all. I'll take down your number and call you by five.

expressions.note: 분실 · 파손 때 보상을 요청하는 것

expressions.en: Would you mind giving me a call?
